# Exploration of Delogu (2019)

```{r}
library(tidytable)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

setwd("experiment1")
```

## Read data
```{r}
stim <- read_excel(file.path("data", "delogu_2019_stim.xlsx")) |>
    mutate(wl = nchar(target))
```

## Exploration
```{r}
stim |> head()
```

Word length
```{r}
stim |>
    select(wl) |>
    summary()

stim |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_density(aes(x = wl), fill = "aliceblue", alpha = .5) +
    labs(title = "Word length") +
    theme_minimal()
```
